import MilneLib.Sheaf.AffineChartSections
import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentRestriction
import MilneLib.Sheaf.EquivariantModuleSections
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientStableOverlap

/-!
# Native quasicoherent sections on affine overlaps

Restriction between affine opens is base change over their actual section
rings. The chart comparison identifies the map with literal sheaf restriction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open MilneLib.StableGroupAction.ModuleLinearization
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) {U V : X.Opens}

private noncomputable def affineOverlapRestrictionIso
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    letI := StableGroupAction.isOpenImmersion_specMap_sectionsRestriction hU hV hVU
    (F.restrict hU.fromSpec).restrict
        (Spec.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op)) ≅ F.restrict hV.fromSpec := by
  letI := StableGroupAction.isOpenImmersion_specMap_sectionsRestriction hU hV hVU
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
      (Spec.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op)) hU.fromSpec).app F).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
      (hU.map_fromSpec hV (homOfLE hVU).op)).app F

/-- Restriction of a quasicoherent sheaf between arbitrary affine opens is
base change for the actual section rings and the actual section map. -/
theorem quasicoherent_affineRestriction_isBaseChange
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hVU : V ≤ U) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) :=
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) Γ(F, V) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
    IsBaseChange Γ(X, V) (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F hVU) := by
  let φ := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := φ.hom.toAlgebra
  letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) Γ(F, V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
  letI := StableGroupAction.isOpenImmersion_specMap_sectionsRestriction hU hV hVU
  let F' := F.restrict hU.fromSpec
  letI := isQuasicoherent_restrict_of_isOpenImmersion hU.fromSpec F
  let N := moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (F'.restrict (Spec.map φ))
  letI : Module Γ(X, U) N := Module.compHom _ φ.hom
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) N := IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
  let f : moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F' →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] N :=
    (affineRestrictionUnitMap φ F').hom
  have hf : IsBaseChange Γ(X, V) f :=
    IsBaseChange.of_equiv (quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso φ F').toLinearEquiv
      (fun m => quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso_one_tmul φ F' m)
  let eM := affineChartSectionsEquiv F hU
  let eN : N ≃ₗ[Γ(X, V)] Γ(F, V) :=
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor.mapIso (affineOverlapRestrictionIso F hU hV hVU)).toLinearEquiv
      |>.trans (affineChartSectionsEquiv F hV)
  apply (IsBaseChange.iff_of_equiv_comm eM eN _).mp hf
  ext m
  change F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (affineChartSectionsEquiv F hU m) =
    affineChartSectionsEquiv F hV
      (((affineOverlapRestrictionIso F hU hV hVU).hom.app ⊤)
        (F'.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Spec.map φ ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op m))
  simp only [affineChartSectionsEquiv_apply]
  dsimp only [affineOverlapRestrictionIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app]
  -- The chart comparisons only insert equality transports between opens.
  change (F.presheaf.map _).hom ((F.presheaf.map _).hom m) =
    (F.presheaf.map _).hom ((F.presheaf.map _).hom
      ((F.presheaf.map _).hom ((F.presheaf.map _).hom m)))
  simp only [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

/-- The literal tensor comparison for restriction between affine opens is
bijective, with the native scalar actions used in invariant-module descent. -/
theorem quasicoherent_affineRestriction_moduleBaseChangeMap_bijective
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hVU : V ≤ U) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) :=
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) Γ(F, V) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
    Function.Bijective (GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleBaseChangeMap
      Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) Γ(F, U) Γ(F, V) (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F hVU)) := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) :=
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) Γ(F, V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
  have h := quasicoherent_affineRestriction_isBaseChange F hU hV hVU
  have heq : GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.moduleBaseChangeMap
      Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) Γ(F, U) Γ(F, V) (sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F hVU) =
      h.equiv.toLinearMap := by
    ext m
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact h.equiv.bijective

end MilneLib
